title: Operator advice evaluates expressions Go leaves unevaluated
claim: A wrapped string slice in a constant array len operand is evaluated and panics although native Go does not evaluate that slice.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=2 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 4m -count=1 -run '^TestArrayLengthLeavesSliceUnevaluated$' -v ./review_operator_arraylength

title: Legal integral floating slice index produces a generic type error
claim: The matcher rewrites value[1.0:] despite the bound being contextually typed int, generating a generic call that infers disallowed float64.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=2 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 4m -count=1 -run '^TestReviewIntegralUntypedFloatBound$' -v ./iast/propagation

title: Injected operator import panics on import-free packages
claim: The new operator advice injects an import into an import-free package; OnCompile assigns it to an uninitialized import-configuration map and aborts compilation.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=2 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 4m -count=1 ./review_operator_noimports

title: Core-type resolution loses valid intersected generic constraints
claim: Early rejection of a mixed union ignores a later embedded constraint that narrows the final type set to a string or byte-slice core type, dropping taint on three supported operations.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=2 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 4m -count=1 -run '^TestReviewIntersectionCoreTypeRetainsProvenance$' -v ./iast/propagation

title: Production dependency is pinned to a changes-requested PR
claim: Orchestrion PR #881 remains unmerged with changes requested; dd-iast-go's immutable pseudo-version will not receive corrections until explicitly repinned and revalidated.
